name: Orun Wheelkeeper
source_profile: ● Orun Wheelkeeper (LN) is an elder responsible for preserving the clans' customary routes and agreements. His knowledge of ancient boundaries makes him invaluable in disputes with settlers and neighboring peoples.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 56 (source excerpt; may be partial)
